claims.title: Recover local dynamical laws from calibrated driven snapshots

quoted_fields.interface: For binary-spin stochastic networks with each flip rate0<=c_i(x_Bi)<=Lambda and at mostk incoming variables includingi,the producer constructs exact finite-drive local balance inversion,retained-system sample acquisition,unknown-input hashing and calibrated noisy-reset recovery. Native irreversibility,zero rates,absorbing classes,slow mixing and unbounded outgoing influence are allowed. Within the declared observed-state/control class,the recovered local tables specify the native generator.
quoted_fields.failure: A sufficient observed state and calibrated reset/control channel preserving the native law are explicit physical resources. Unknown controller backaction can exactly mask a changed native law. Same incorrect-neighborhood validation can miss omitted inputs. Elementary molecular implementation is unearned:the compiled chemical network is formal,with maintained fuel/waste accounting and symbolic native parameters,not actual molecules or an experiment. Maximum likelihood beat local inversion on the same reported dataset. No broad invention-of-local-learning,priority,practical advantage or civilisation-impact claim.
